text:
That's a very valid concern, Sarah. It's completely reasonable to worry about the potential impact on your work environment. You've already been through a lot with the previous harassment, and it's understandable that you'd want someone who prioritizes respect and a positive work culture.

Have you considered reaching out to HR or someone in a higher management level to express your concerns and see if there's any way to ensure a smoother transition? Sometimes, having a voice in the process can make a big difference.

Also, remember that you're not alone in this. Many people have gone through similar situations and have come out stronger on the other side. You've already shown incredible resilience by speaking up about the harassment and seeking support. That takes a lot of courage.

If you feel comfortable, I can also offer some suggestions on how to approach HR or higher management. Sometimes, having a plan or knowing what to say can make it feel less daunting.

How does that sound?
